setup.title: Create the Family calendar
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works.

invalid.name: Enter the Family's name.
invalid.password: The password needs at least 10 characters.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.

recovery.title: Forgot the password?
recovery.sent: If that address is registered, a recovery link is on its way. Check your inbox.
recovery.done: Your password is changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with the new one.
recovery.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
recovery.newSetupCodeHint: The recovery email was used up, so this calendar needs a new password. Enter the setup code from the server and choose a new Family Password.
recovery.emailHint: Where we send the link if the Family Password is forgotten. The new address must be confirmed from its inbox.
recovery.emailSent: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. The change applies once you open it.

errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.

notice.app: Something went wrong in the app.

errors.tryAgain: Try again. If it keeps happening, report it.
errors.tryOffline: Check the internet and try again.
errors.reportFailed: Couldn't send the report. Try again later.
errors.tooManyReports: Too many reports in the last hour. Try again later.

log.title: Error log
log.empty: No errors in the last 90 days.

password.title: Change the Family Password
password.hint: Every device, this one included, will need to sign in again.
password.confirm: Every device will need to sign in again. Continue?

persons.title: Persons
persons.name: Name
persons.nicknamesHint: Separated by commas. Used by Voice Entry and never shown in the views.
persons.archiveHint: An archived Person leaves pickers and filters but stays on past Entries and Tasks.
persons.inUse: Entries or Tasks mention this Person. Archive them instead.
persons.keepBirthday: Keep {{name}}'s Birthday on the calendar, for the whole Family? Cancel removes it.

entryTypes.title: Entry Types
entryTypes.name: Name
entryTypes.defaultsHint: They pre-fill new Entries of this type. Changing them never changes existing Entries.
entryTypes.moveEntries: Choose where each {{name}} Entry goes. Those you leave move to General.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: Notifications for Entries and Tasks on this device only.
reminders.notSetUp: Reminders are not set up on this server.
reminders.unsupported: This browser cannot show push notifications.
reminders.addToHome: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to the Home Screen first, then open it from there to turn on Reminders.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the browser or system settings, then try again.
reminders.failed: Could not turn on notifications. Try again.
reminders.familyWide: Items for no Person in particular (Family-wide) always remind.

entries.title: Title
entries.familyWideHint: With nobody picked, the Entry is for the whole Family.
entries.privateHint: Stays discreet on the wall, in Reminders, in the Feed and in the Briefing.
entries.badTime: The end must come after the start.
entries.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}" for good? This can't be undone.
entries.birthdaySynced: This Birthday follows {{name}}'s date of birth: change its date or Person on the Person.
entries.birthYearKnown: Birth year known (the date above is the date of birth, so the age shows)
entries.birthdayLocked: This Birthday's date and Person change only on its Person.

tasks.title: Title
tasks.familyWideHint: With nobody picked, the Task is for the whole Family.
tasks.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}" for good? This can't be undone.
tasks.repeatNeedsDate: Give it a due date to make it repeat.
tasks.repeatHint: Ticking it brings up the next one, due on the first date after today.

checklists.name: Name
checklists.periodHint: Before its start it isn't pending; at its end its undone Tasks are overdue, undated ones included.
checklists.personsHint: Each Task keeps its own Persons.
checklists.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}" and its Tasks for good?
checklists.repeatHint: When the next date comes, a new round starts: every Task undone, dates moved with the period.
checklists.useAgainHint: Starts a new round now: every Task undone. Only this round's result is kept.
checklists.remindAtStart: Remind at 09:00 on the first day

holidays.title: Public Holidays
holidays.hint: Shown on every device; each device can hide them from the Person filter.
holidays.municipalityHint: A municipal holiday that isn't listed can be added as a yearly Entry.

feeds.title: Calendar Feeds
feeds.hint: Other calendar apps (your phone, your work calendar) can subscribe to a read-only address.
feeds.confirmReplace: Replace the address of "{{name}}"? The old address stops working.
feeds.confirmRevoke: Revoke "{{name}}"? Its address stops working for good.
feeds.name: Feed name
feeds.noneHint: With nobody picked, the Feed covers everyone.
feeds.copyNow: Copy this address now; it won't be shown again.

offline.notice: You're offline. This is the last loaded calendar; changes need a connection.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Your data is also kept outside Cloudflare. A full Export includes Private items.

briefing.title: Briefing
briefing.failed: The briefing could not be refreshed. Try again.

weather.title: Weather
weather.hint: The selected place is used on every device.
weather.searchFailed: The search is not available right now.

voice.title: Voice Entry
voice.failed: Could not understand that. Try again.
voice.hint: Say or type a sentence to add an Entry or Task. This device only.
voice.readback: Read back aloud and ask before saving
voice.scopeQuestion: Only this time or from now on?
voice.oneAtATime: One thing at a time, please
voice.refused: Voice Entry doesn't delete; open the item to delete it
voice.locked: A Birthday's date and Person change on the Person

display.otherWeek: Another week is shown · Back to today

school.endSecondary: Last day of school: years 9, 11 and 12
school.endMiddle: Last day of school: years 5 to 8 and 10
school.endPrimary: Last day of school: pre-school and years 1 to 4

waste.title: Rubbish collection
waste.hint: The days each bin is collected in your street. They show on the calendar when "Rubbish collection" is on in the filter.
